notes: A transmission statement of the compiler's routes, not a saying: four routes, each read as written
«رويته عن أبي» is the compiler's father, a bare relation; the text names Qasim b. Yahya first, but the chain order runs from the compiler's shaykh, so the levels follow the chain order
«جميعا» marks co-transmitters the text does not name: they are not written as links
